notes.title: New Game Logo! 🖼️
notes.content:
[h2][b]Dear Players! 🤝[/b][/h2]

[h3]Before the next key event in the development of the Car Mechanic Shop Simulator, we decided to present you a [b]new logo[/b] for the game! 🥳[/h3]

[h3]This new logo is a significant step forward in aligning the game's visual identity with its core gameplay.  🎮[/h3]

The [b]new logo[/b] has been designed to better reflect the essence of the Car Mechanic Shop Simulator. The elements such as a wrench and a gear visually show the game's focus on selling car parts and  🔧 managing a workshop 🛒 making it instantly recognizable to all players. 

Make sure to leave a comment with what you think about it, and we will announce the next milestone in the game's development very soon - stay tuned and add the game to your Steam Wishlist! ✅

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3401000/Car_Mechanic_Shop_Simulator/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355137/cdf5ba4b9b2d995ea19825bcabdc971ca02f126b.png[/img][/url]


[url=https://discord.gg/TBQGEJU44W][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45355137/357c75611e60db47c4b2339702ca6db4a1ed87cd.png[/img][/url]

See you soon!
Car Mechanic Shop Simulator Team
